title: Faction
description: A faction (#483): a player-facing name, a symbol, its own names for the ranks of the player's standing with it, five each way from neutral, and the instances it holds when a world starts (#637). One file per faction, named after its id. Each player's standing is kept in their profile by the faction's id, so an id is never reused or changed once shipped.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

symbol.description: One or two characters that mark the faction, e.g. its territory on the Survey, so it's never told apart by color alone (#68).

territory.description: The instances it holds when a world starts, by blueprint name (#637). No instance is in two factions' territory.

ranks_up.description: The ranks' names above neutral, from standing +1 up to +5.

ranks_down.description: The ranks' names below neutral, from standing -1 down to -5.
